items.label: symptom
items.evidence: I am unsure if the root cause lies within Xarray's concatenation logic, Dask's task graph generation for mixed dtypes, or an interaction between the two.
items.rationale: Reports behavior and MVCE; author explicitly unsure of the cause. Only notes that astype(float64) avoids the issue.
items.author: josephnowak

items.label: fix_sketch
items.evidence: On our side, `concat` should cast to the common dtype before broadcasting, and/or broadcast dask arrays with chunks that match the other inputs.
items.rationale: Diagnoses that broadcast via set_dims in ensure_common_dims in concat.py precedes the dask dtype cast, which materializes a huge chunk. Proposes casting to the common dtype before broadcasting, which is exactly what the reference does. It doesn't give code.
items.author: headtr1ck
